description: AR AEB PCW pre-warning fires but PCW state is not active, so no icon is drawn. gate=ADAS fusion(0x4C1 6.2-6.3)=1, ONLINE_0x32D(0x32D 5.6)=1, PCWStateS(0x32D 3.2)=0. The PCW branch requires (pcwPreWarning_==0x1 && pcwStates_==0x1); pre-warning alone without state does not match, so mAEBImage is not drawn (this is the absent-state counterpart to baseline TC-AEB-PCW-PREWARN which set 3.2=1).
